decision: NONE for the proposed isolated forecast intervention: online future-supervised cognition does drive actions, but no separately exposed Goal/action-conditioned physical-forecast contract was identified
scope: Five small repository source/document files plus GitHub and Hugging Face metadata. No claim about uninspected implementations or the complete paper architecture.

repository.readme_implementation_status: README.md line 6 explicitly calls this an unofficial implementation based on open-source frameworks and datasets.

online_path.deployment: deploy/wog_policy_sim.py:107-136 receives a current RGB image and task_description and calls predict_action(image,instruction). Changing the description resets policy state at lines 122-124.
online_path.model: vla/vla.py:302-370 formats the instruction into the VLM prompt, processes the image, obtains one VLM cognition feature, then calls action_model.inference(cognition_features). No v_enc, qformer, or oformer call appears in this inference method.
online_path.action_sampler: action_model/action_model.py:56-75 samples Gaussian action noise and integrates the action flow over num_steps=10 grid points (nine updates), calling net(x,t,z) without a future/perceptual tensor.
online_path.stage_two: action_model/action_model.py:38-40 sets use_per_attn=False when train_venc=False. action_model/models.py:220-226 constructs the perceptual embedder only when use_per_attn is true; lines 295-301 consume per_token only on that branch.
online_path.execution: The default action chunk contains 16 seven-dimensional actions. deploy/wog_policy_sim.py:138-187 optionally temporally ensembles the chunk, selects the first resulting action, scales translation/rotation, and applies gripper processing. The ensemble implementation was not read.
online_path.interpretation: The shared VLM is trained with future-feature auxiliary supervision, and its online cognition z is actually consumed by the action flow. This is a real native future-supervised representation-to-action route, consistent with condition-space world guidance; it must not be described as world modeling being entirely unused at inference. Only the explicit future reconstruction branch is absent from the checked inference call path. The missing property is a separately exposed physical-future/Goal/candidate-action intervention contract, not absence of any learned world-guidance consumer.

training_path.truth_features: vla/vla.py:160-172 encodes provided future_pixel_values with frozen FutureEnc plus qformer.
training_path.stage_one: The encoded future features are passed to the action loss at lines 175-181; train_venc=True enables the action model's perceptual attention.
training_path.stage_two_auxiliary: When train_venc=False, vla/vla.py:185-192 computes oformer(obs_ins), cosine-aligns it to detached encoded future targets, and adds 0.3 times this auxiliary loss. This supervises the shared VLM from which online cognition z is extracted; z then enters the native action flow. The explicit oformer output itself is not passed to predict_action or ActionModel.inference in the inspected source. The source does not establish that z is a calibrated physical state or candidate-action-conditioned rollout.
training_path.not_an_inference_do_action_contract: Training targets are demonstrated future observations. The online entrypoint accepts no candidate future action sequence to condition a physical prediction on. Its action-flow x is a noisy generated action sequence, not a physical state forecast.

contract_assessment.independent_goal_branch: Not found in the inspected path. One instruction feeds the shared VLM cognition representation used by action generation. Editing it changes the task condition; no separately protected policy Goal versus forecast Goal is exposed.
contract_assessment.current_observation: The public inference argument is a current PIL image. The deploy wrapper stores image_history but passes only image to predict_action.
contract_assessment.forecast_action_condition: None exposed: predict_action accepts image, instruction, normalization key and generation kwargs, with no candidate action input to an explicit world forecast.
contract_assessment.forecast_time_alignment: No online forecast frames/states or timestamped physical rollout are returned. The 16-action chunk is not evidence of a 16-frame physical forecast or a known wall-clock prediction horizon.
contract_assessment.candidate_scores_or_ranking: No forecast-based candidate scoring/selection found in the inspected action generation path.
contract_assessment.new_security_mechanism: None identified. Adding an explicit forecast consumer or arbitrary internal feature writer would create a new system/interface; this screen does not justify doing so.

checkpoint_metadata.validation: Only publication metadata checked. No checkpoint/config tensor contents, compatibility, model capability, inference time or VRAM requirement were validated. Listed bytes are file sizes, not measured GPU memory.

static_readiness_caveats: The inspected standalone WoGSimInference constructor does not assign cfg_scale/use_ddim/num_ddim_steps although step references them at lines 133-135. An uninspected caller could set them; the provided class itself is not evidence of a successfully executed deployment.
vla/vla.py:278 loads action_model with strict=False and lines 286-297 can leave qformer initialized when checkpoint keys do not match. No strict inference compatibility was tested.

These ordinary implementation/readiness issues are not security findings and are not the principal exclusion reason; a native future-supervised z-to-action path exists, but the proposed separate physical-forecast intervention contract is absent from the checked path.
next_action: Stop this carrier screen; no model download, runtime setup, Clean run or Goal-Swap experiment proposed.
